title: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: Suppose your university is seeking students' opinions on the necessity of making College Chinese a compulsory course. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: The question of whether College Chinese should be a compulsory course has sparked heated discussion on campus. In my view, making it compulsory is both necessary and wise. Admittedly, some students argue that Chinese is their mother tongue and needs no further study. Yet this view overlooks two facts. First, a solid command of Chinese sharpens our thinking and expression. Many science majors write reports full of grammatical errors and muddled logic, which weakens their careers. A required course would help them communicate clearly. What's more, classical Chinese carries our cultural heritage. Through reading poems and essays, students inherit values and a sense of identity that no other subject offers. Therefore, I firmly believe College Chinese deserves a place as a compulsory course. It is not a burden but an investment in both our language ability and our cultural roots.
keyPoints: 一句背景一句立场。首段落实了『首段：一句背景一句立场』：第一句 The question of whether College Chinese should be a compulsory course has sparked heated discussion 用套架点 出争议背景；第二句 In my view, making it compulsory is both necessary and wise 立刻亮明赞成立 场，开头就让阅卷人看清你选哪边。

让步—观点—例证—小结落地。主体段先用 Admittedly, some students argue... Yet this view overlooks 让步再反驳；再用 First 与 What's more 分领两条理由；每条都配例子——理工科学生 write reports full of grammatical errors and muddled logic、classical Chinese carries our cultural heritage，做到了不空喊口号。
连接词重申再升华。尾段用 Therefore 领起，Therefore, I firmly believe College Chinese deserves a place 换句重申立场；末句 It is not a burden but an investment 用『不是A而是B』把意义 拔高，首尾呼应、没有引入新理由。
